The Process

How it works.

You install Archie, build an agent, and message it from anywhere. Here’s the whole picture, one step at a time.

The handover

What handing something over looks like.

You message your agent the way you’d text a friend (“what’s on my calendar?” “move my 3 o’clock,” “catch me up on today’s meetings”). It goes away and works, comes back if it needs you, and tells you when it’s done.

It holds the things you’d otherwise carry in your head. Tell it once: the follow-up on Friday, the detail to check before the call. It keeps hold of it, and messages you first when the time comes.

No terminal, no code

You do not need to be technical.

Archie is a desktop app: no code, no config files, no terminal. Want a person beside you? That’s what guided setup is for.

The moving parts

How it all connects.

Your agent runs on your own computer, built from a handful of parts you choose. Here’s the whole thing, and everywhere it reaches.

You Your chat app Telegram, Discord, Slack, Matrix or iMessage, you just message it
you message it · it replies

reaches out to

Your apps Email, calendar, and more. It sends email and changes your calendar only after you approve each one, and it can’t spend money.

Your files and its memory live on your computer. The private codes that let it reach your AI account sit in your computer’s built-in password store, where we have no way to read them. When it thinks, it talks to the AI company directly, on your account, never through us. See how we prove it →

The whole list

What you actually need.

Less than you’d think. Three things, and you probably have one of them already. A chat app makes four, and that one can wait: you can talk to your agent inside Archie itself.

1

A computer you can leave on

One you don’t mind leaving on, because your agent answers while Archie is running. Already have one? Use it: a laptop just needs to not fall asleep, and we’ll sort that with you. If you’d rather have one that’s always ready, a Mac mini is the easy answer.

It runs on both Mac and Windows. Archie is in testing and not for sale yet. See where it stands → The waitlist hears the day it lands.

2

An account with an AI company

Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI (GPT), Google (Gemini), Groq or xAI (Grok), pay-as-you-go. Groq is free to start and needs no card, and Google is free in most countries. You pay for what your agent actually does: around $4.40 a month for a handful of tasks a day, more if you lean on it constantly. Here’s that worked out for 3 levels of use. It’s billed straight to you and you can cap it. We never touch it and we never see it.

Archie itself is $30 a month or $299 a year when it ships, a separate cost from guided setup. Every cost, in full.

3

An Otian account, and a plan

Archie asks you to sign in when it opens, and a browser window handles it. A plan is $30 a month or $299 a year, and you can change or stop it whenever you like. On our side it holds your email address, your plan, and your paid add-ons. Never a conversation.

The same cost named above, not a second charge. Every cost, in full.

+

Optional: a chat app, to be reached anywhere

Telegram, Discord, Slack, Matrix or, on a Mac, iMessage. Not something to sort out before you start, since you can talk to your agent inside Archie itself. A chat app is what lets it reach you anywhere; your agent lives there like a contact, and it is the same conversation from your desk or your phone. Telegram is the quickest, and the one most people choose.

On a Mac, iMessage needs no account at all, and your agent answers in the conversation you have with yourself. WhatsApp is the one still missing, because it does not let an app like this answer on your behalf. That is its rule, not our choice.

Setup

Your path to a running agent.

5 steps from a quiet computer to an agent you can message from anywhere, and one promise for whatever comes after.

01

Pick a computer it can live on

Any computer you can leave on will do, and the one you already own probably qualifies. The whole list is above.

Install Archie

Download the desktop app and open it. Archie is in testing and not for sale yet. See where it stands →

02
03

Build your agent

Name it, then shape it with add-ons: Skills, Routines, and Personalities. Start with the free built-ins, and browse the marketplace when you want more.

Connect your chat app

Link your agent to Telegram, Discord, Slack, Matrix or, on a Mac, iMessage, whichever you already use. You can talk to it in Archie itself before you pick one.

04
05

Message it from anywhere

Your agent does the work on your computer and replies in your chat. It sends email and updates your calendar only after you approve each one: it proposes, you approve. It can’t spend money, though; that ability doesn’t exist in Archie at all.

Hit a ceiling? Tell us

If Archie can’t do it yet, we’ll build the add-on. Every commissioned add-on becomes a marketplace listing, so your request becomes everyone’s feature.

06
2 ways in

On your own, or with us beside you.

You can do all of this yourself. Guided setup is for everyone who’d rather not do it alone.

Do it yourself

  • Install Archie and build your agent at your own pace
  • Every add-on is included with Archie. If we ever charge for one, buying it is permanent
  • Connect only the accounts you choose; your keys live in your system’s keychain, where we have no way to read them
  • Hit a ceiling? Tell us, and we’ll build the add-on

Take the guided path

  • A free discovery call to map out what you want
  • We build with you over screen share, teaching every step in plain language
  • Bigger setups can take more than one session, and we tell you how many on that free call
  • Archie is $30 a month or $299 a year, separate from your sessions
  • Read more about guided setup
